title: Competency question set
description: The Phase 2/3 synthesis gate (docs/PLAN.md Section 5): for a fixture, a set of questions a competent staff officer should be able to answer from the source. A synthesized OKF bundle passes if an agent reading only the bundle answers as well as an agent reading the source, and every answer cites.

$schema.description: Editor-tooling convenience pointer back to this schema file; not semantically meaningful.

fixtureId.description: The id of the source fixture this question set is graded against — a fixtures/doctrine/manifest.json document id (Phase 2), or an operating-model bundle id (Phase 3).

description.description: One-line summary of what this question set is exercising.

question.description: The question, phrased the way a staff officer would ask it.

expectedAnswerNotes.description: What a competent answer must contain — grading notes for a judge, not a literal string to match verbatim.

sourceAnchor.description: Page or section anchor in the source document that grounds the expected answer, e.g. 'p. 14, para 2.3'.

requiresOperatingModel.description: True for the Phase 3 second question set: answerable only by combining the source with the operating-model bundle (docs/PLAN.md Section 5, Phase 3), e.g. 'which C2 node in this enterprise owns the step this paragraph describes?'
